mode_taxonomy.from_zero_prestaged: criar do zero: novos IDs de campanha, conjunto, creative e anúncio; mídia nova pre-stageada
mode_taxonomy.clone_prestaged: clonar com criativos novos: copiar campanha/conjunto/anúncios-fonte por lineage, substituindo a mídia e o payload criativo por assets novos do Drive
mode_taxonomy.pure_clone: duplicar igual: equivalente operacional ao botão Duplicar do Ads Manager; deep copy da campanha vencedora sem substituir o conteúdo criativo; a Meta pode reutilizar ou rematerializar Creative IDs, e o mesmo post/social proof só é confirmado quando o readback mantém o effective_object_story_id da fonte

mode_selection_policy: never collapse the three modes; daily new-creative cohorts use clone_prestaged, while pure_clone is only materialized by an explicit request to duplicate the campaign identically
media_policy: prestage before campaign manifest; clone_prestaged uses source ad copies with lineage and new Drive creatives; from_zero_prestaged creates campaign, adset, creatives and ads directly and forbids every source clone ID; pure_clone reuses the source hierarchy without Drive media substitution
ad_naming_policy: CPV prestaged modes require canonical_filename; ad and creative display names use canonical stem; technical asset_id is audit-only
failure_reporting_policy: every operator-visible failure identifies operation/campaigns and states stage, cause, consequence, correction in progress and useful recovery status; no internal paths or credentials
failure_write_gate: standing Rodolfo authority: errors inside an authorized request trigger readback-first automatic recovery of the missing or invalid layer until completion; no blind replay and no scope expansion
scheduled_creation_budget_reporting: every completed scheduled creation reports active account budget, effective dynamic envelope, remaining amount inside that envelope and USD source basis
creation_lifecycle_gate: scheduled creation is a conditional phase after D1-D3 analysis, pause and scale decisions; a creation_hold blocks all new campaign writes until Rodolfo or Nicolas releases it

appsecret_proof.pending: enable only after every v3 server call has ARES_META_APP_SECRET and Meta App Require App Secret is coordinated
